items: Treat every review as a gift: it shows you your business through the guest's eyes, builds trust with future guests and helps your local ranking on Google.
Reply to positive reviews within a day or two, use the guest's name, mention something specific they said, address any small complaint and invite them back.
For a review you believe is fake, post one short, calm reply, report it through the platform's tools, appeal with evidence if needed and keep records of any pattern.
Ask for reviews at the moments guests are happiest, such as right after the meal, at payment, through a QR code on the receipt or by SMS soon after the visit.
